evidence.proved: the price table gives the 1 GB plan at 985円 including tax on one-month payment, 873円 a month equivalent on twelve months, with setup free on 1 GB and 2 GB shapes, a 3-core 2 GB shape at 1,446円 and a 10-core 16 GB shape at 16,636円, and states that the minimum period is three months and that a service-maintenance surcharge may be added
a third-party comparison lists the 1 GB shape as 2 cores, 1 GB, 100 GB SSD with unlimited transfer and a three-month minimum, and states that no free trial is offered; reported
the vendor price table states the setup and one-month prices from the free-setup 1 GB plan to the 16 GB plan

notes: The unlimited-transfer claim comes from a third-party table and is not on the vendor price page read, so it is recorded as reported. A 2011 blog describes a fifteen-day free trial with a 5 Mbps downstream cap on this product; the current third-party comparison says no trial exists, and the vendor page does not mention one, so the trial is treated as withdrawn rather than current. The two sources disagree and the newer one wins, which is the finding. Payment method was not read on a vendor page this session; the card identity cost is inferred from a monthly or hourly billing model, and the signup page is the route that would settle it.
